At +50 kHz the base path gives −98.18045° and output offset +50 kHz.
A center-tone correction removes an intercept; a frequency sweep identifies slope.
Frequency sweeps or suitably varied modulation test phase curvature.
All curves are exact responses of the stated ideal operators, not measured filters.
